overview: Inner Thicket is the shadowed core of Shadeweaver’s Thicket, where corruption spreads through roots and wildlife.
history: The thicket canopy thickened after seismic shifts beneath Luclin.
Shadow corruption seeped into the forest from deeper caverns.
Netherbian burrow faults opened beneath the thicket floor.
Grimling infiltrators began using the shadows to avoid Vah Shir patrols.
Vah Shir hunters reported wildlife mutations and corrupted beasts.
hooks: A corrupted thicket beast stalks the forest interior.
Netherbian burrowers erupt from new faultlines.
Grimling infiltrators attempt to establish hidden camps.
Shadow corruption spreads through root networks.
